description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LeaveRequestService class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It includes tests for methods such as fetching leave request DAOs, retrieving leave status mappings, detailed leave requests, and workflow actions, specifically focusing on the functionality relevant to leave request service operations.

classes.name: LeaveRequestServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing LeaveRequestService functionalities within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Tests that the getLeaveRequestDao method returns an instance of LeaveRequestDao.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Tests mapping between leave status IDs and their names, verifying correct retrieval from DAO.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Verifies the correct name retrieval for a given leave status ID, and proper exception handling for invalid IDs.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Checks that the method retrieves the correct status ID from a status name and throws exception for unknown names.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusByNames
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of multiple leave status IDs based on an array of status names, including exception handling.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Verifies that detailed leave request objects are correctly assembled with sorted leave dates.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Tests retrieval of permitted workflows for a leave request based on user roles, leave types, and leave states.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflowsWithDeletedLeaveType
methods.description: Ensures that workflows are correctly retrieved even if the leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: getMockWorkflowActions
methods.description: Creates mock workflow action objects for testing workflow retrieval functions.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Validates the assembly of detailed leave objects with their respective leaves and dates.
